name: Chronic Inflammatory Demyelinating Polyneuropathy
definition: Immune-mediated peripheral neuropathy causing progressive or relapsing motor and sensory dysfunction over at least several weeks, with demyelinating electrodiagnostic features.

redFlags.item: Marked asymmetry or systemic features suggesting alternative disease

investigations.MRI: MRI nerve roots may support selected cases but is not primary diagnosis.

green: Immunotherapy when diagnostic criteria are met
amber: IVIG, steroids and plasma exchange require individualized specialist planning.
red: Urgent red-flag features override routine conservative or Ayurvedic pathways.

ayurvedaFramework.text: Vata/Dhatu neuropathy phenotype may be documented in parallel.

patientEducation.summary: Immune-mediated peripheral neuropathy causing progressive or relapsing motor and sensory dysfunction over at least several weeks, with demyelinating electrodiagnostic features.
patientEducation.urgent: Seek urgent assessment for acute/progressive neurological deficit, sphincter change, severe infection/systemic illness, major trauma, vascular compromise or other listed red flags.
